label: Early copy phase (absolute steps 10-12) in long sequences
explanation: Active only during the copy phase (never in the original phase or at the <DEL> step). It fires on the first few copy steps of long sequences, which fall at absolute steps 10-12: L=9 recall 1-3 and L=8 recall 2-3. L>=8 holds about 98% of the activation mass and L<=6 essentially never fires. Strongest at recall_idx 2 of L=9 (t=11), where the top examples reach about 0.95-1.0 of max; recall 1 and 3 are weaker. A weaker secondary mode at the last steps of L=9 sequences (recall_idx 7-8, t=16-17) holds about 6% of mass. Within the window, activation is modulated by the input token (b, d, f, 0 have the highest lift) and rises somewhat with digit count, but no token rule sharpens it much. Precision is limited (~0.6): about 40% of in-window steps stay below threshold. It does not fire on middle copy steps (recall 4-6) or in short sequences.
